messi-demo.zh: 第一张卡。验证「一句话 → 四层素材 → Blender → 实时 3D」全链路跑通。
messi-demo.en: The very first card. It proved the full pipeline: one sentence → 4 layers → Blender → live 3D.

mj-demo.zh: 舞台光效与音乐主题的尝试——镭射质感第一次大改版。
mj-demo.en: A first pass at stage lighting and music themes — and the first big foil-effect upgrade.

frida-kahlo-mexican-painter.zh: 公开投稿画廊的第一张永久卡，也是展厅的第 6 张收藏。
frida-kahlo-mexican-painter.en: The first permanent card from the public-submission gallery — and the 6th in the hall.

snow-leopard-aurora-ridge.zh: 雪原与极光，野生动物在极光下的静谧瞬间。
snow-leopard-aurora-ridge.en: A snow leopard under the northern lights — wildlife in a frozen, glowing moment.

great-sage-sun-wukong.zh: 东方神话走进画廊：齐天大圣，傲世苍穹。
great-sage-sun-wukong.en: Eastern myth joins the hall: the Great Sage, defying heaven.

taikonaut-stellar-expedition.zh: 航天主题，星辰大海的远征。
taikonaut-stellar-expedition.en: A space expedition — dreams among the stars.

marco-reus-bvb-kapitain.zh: 德国球星系列开篇：多特蒙德队长，德语卡背。
marco-reus-bvb-kapitain.en: First German card — the BVB captain, with a German back story.

marco-reus-wm-2014-verpasst.zh: 国家队篇章：2014 年那个错过的大力神杯之夜。
marco-reus-wm-2014-verpasst.en: The national-team chapter — the 2014 night the trophy slipped away.

marco-reus-la-galaxy-neue-horizonte.zh: 罗伊斯远赴美职联的新章节。
marco-reus-la-galaxy-neue-horizonte.en: Reus' new chapter across the Atlantic.

satyajit-ray-bengali-maestro.zh: 孟加拉语文字层与西孟加拉字体验证——致敬电影大师。
satyajit-ray-bengali-maestro.en: Bengali text layer and font rendering verified — a tribute to the film maestro.

neeltje-friesian-kalundborg.zh: 朋友的马：密码解锁的私藏卡，卡背是一段丹麦语故事。
neeltje-friesian-kalundborg.en: A friend's horse — a passcode-locked private card with a Danish story.

card-elijah-lin-d.zh: 第一张真实公众投稿——自动审核 + 自动渲染管线正式上线。
card-elijah-lin-d.en: The first real public submission — the auto-review & auto-render pipeline went live.

messi-fc-barcelona.zh: 「巴萨传承」001：诺坎普之夜，红蓝十年。
messi-fc-barcelona.en: FC Barcelona Legacy 001 — a night at Camp Nou.

johan-cruyff-el-arquitecto.zh: 传承 005：现代足球的建筑师，克圣。
johan-cruyff-el-arquitecto.en: Legacy 005 — the architect of modern football.

messi-inter-miami.zh: 传承 003：新大陆的传奇，迈阿密之夏。
messi-inter-miami.en: Legacy 003 — a legend in the New World.

messi-world-cup-2022.zh: 传承 004：第三颗星，卡塔尔之夜。
messi-world-cup-2022.en: Legacy 004 — the third star, the Doha night.

pep-guardiola-tiki-taka.zh: 传承 006：系列收官——战术大师瓜迪奥拉。
pep-guardiola-tiki-taka.en: Legacy 006 — the maestro closes the series.

eletrico-28-lisboa.zh: 里斯本的城市名片——28 路黄色电车。选择性着色：电车全彩、老城黑白，献给热爱这座城市的 Inês。
eletrico-28-lisboa.en: Lisbon's moving icon — the yellow Tram 28. Selective color: the tram glows, the old city fades to monochrome. Dedicated to Inês, whose love for Lisbon made this card possible.

haaland-machine-robot.zh: 哈兰德多重宇宙开篇：111 球 0 情绪，机器人梗首发，呆萌不炫酷。
haaland-machine-robot.en: Opening of the Haaland Multiverse: 111 goals, zero feelings — the robot meme, cute not cool.

haaland-meditation.zh: 打坐庆祝名场面进画廊——别人呐喊，我入定。
haaland-meditation.en: The lotus-pose celebration joins the hall — the world screams, he meditates.

haaland-majin-buu.zh: 撞脸《龙珠》魔人布欧实锤，本人回应「我不否认」。
haaland-majin-buu.en: The Majin Buu face-match, confirmed by his own words: 'I don't disagree.'

haaland-moskau-anthem.zh: 《哈哈哈兰德》神曲篇——哈兰哈兰，哈哈哈哈。
haaland-moskau-anthem.en: The anthem chapter — Haalaland, ha-ha-ha-ha-land. Wash your brain, then keep singing.

haaland-viking-kriger.zh: 维京战士（挪威语卡）——谷歌彩蛋「维京划船」的致敬。
haaland-viking-kriger.en: The Viking warrior (in Norwegian) — a tribute to Google's Viking Row easter egg.

kenji-kishimoto.zh: 《破碎的我》里会隐身的日裔美籍抵抗战士——Omega Point 的隐形心脏，战争里最锐利的讽刺旁白者。
kenji-kishimoto.en: The invisible heart of Omega Point — the Japanese-American resistance fighter from Shatter Me who vanishes into the war's best one-liners.

pouch-invader.zh: 朋友 Lay 投稿的搞笑卡——猫强占袋鼠育儿袋，副标题 The Laytenant 三合一双关（中尉/租客/Lay）。
pouch-invader.en: A comedy card from friend Lay — the cat claims the pouch; the kangaroo never signed up. Subtitle pun: The Laytenant = lieutenant + tenant + Lay.

haaland-magdeburg.zh: 爆射贴脸被封「人类高质量马德堡半球实验」，物理课本风梗卡。
haaland-magdeburg.en: The shot so hard the ball stayed glued to a defender's face — textbook-illustration meme.

haaland-eat-kid.zh: 世界杯广告「生吃小孩」Q 版化，黑色幽默变呆萌。
haaland-eat-kid.en: The 'eat-the-kid' World Cup ad, Q-versioned into adorable black humor.

haaland-raccoon.zh: 世界杯后扛浣熊标本 + 威士忌下飞机，机场狗仔名场面梗卡。
haaland-raccoon.en: Post-World Cup arrival with a raccoon and a whisky — airport paparazzi gold.

haaland-wanglaoji.zh: 7.5 亿阅读的蹩脚中文王老吉广告，红金喜庆梗卡。
haaland-wanglaoji.en: The 750M-reads Wanglaoji ad with his earnest Chinese — festive fire-breathing meme.

haaland-bun-haartie.zh: 90 分钟不散的丸子头 + 淘宝 3 万搜索同款发圈，时尚单品海报梗卡。
haaland-bun-haartie.en: The 90-minute-proof bun and his 30k-search hair tie, styled as a fashion-poster meme.

haaland-shark-grin.zh: 哈兰德标志性鲨鱼牙大笑，全网表情包级。这次不冷峻，直接深海化。
haaland-shark-grin.en: Haaland's signature shark-tooth grin, meme-wild and deep-sea blue. The Machine is cool; the Shark is happy.

haaland-scallion.zh: 中国网民拿大葱根茎复刻哈兰德金发前倾庆祝体态，他本人主动转发。大葱即本人，田园即球场。
haaland-scallion.en: Chinese fans recreated Haaland's celebration with a scallion — and he reposted it himself. The scallion IS the striker.

haaland-goalie-water.zh: 哈兰德场上偷喝对手门将水瓶被抓包的名场面，尴尬假笑定格。机器人也会渴。
haaland-goalie-water.en: Haaland's famous sideline water-bottle heist, caught in 4K with a sheepish grin. Even robots get thirsty.

haaland-tom-cat.zh: 网友发现哈兰德神似《猫和老鼠》Tom：金发、蓝白配色、锲而不舍。Jerry 和 111 个后卫都跑不掉。
haaland-tom-cat.en: The internet's face-match of the century: Haaland IS Tom from Tom & Jerry. Jerry never stood a chance — neither did 111 defenders.

haaland-chongqing-metro.zh: 网友玩'重庆必吃榜'梗，哈兰德真拍视频张嘴吞穿楼轻轨。李子坝名场面，山城魔幻遇上梗王。
haaland-chongqing-metro.en: "Chongqing's must-eat list" — fans joked the metro-through-building is a dish, and Haaland actually filmed himself eating it.

vc-lance-vance.zh: 兰斯是汤米第一个盟友，也是全游戏最魔性的名场面——霓虹舞池里那段笨拙又自信的舞步成了无数玩家的童年记忆。只是没人想到，跳舞的兄弟最后会把枪口对准你。
vc-lance-vance.en: The most memed dance in gaming, from the brother who'd later betray you. Disco ball, purple suit, and a prophecy.

vc-ricardo-diaz.zh: 迪亚兹是罪恶城最大的毒枭，傲慢、残暴、自以为无人能撼动。可惜他惹错了人——Rub Out 一役，老毒枭的雪茄在自家庄园永远熄了。
vc-ricardo-diaz.en: The drug lord who ruled Vice City with a mansion, a cigar and pure arrogance — until Tommy paid a visit.

vc-auntie-poulet.zh: 波莱特是小海地区的巫毒女巫，用蜡烛和咒语给汤米'祝福'——皮糙肉厚、伤口快速愈合。罪恶城最魔幻的一页，写在烟雾缭绕的巫毒小店里。
vc-auntie-poulet.en: Vice City's strangest ally: candles, spirits and blessings that actually work. The voodoo queen of Little Haiti.

vc-ken-rosenberg.zh: 肯是汤米的总律师：永远紧张、永远大汗淋漓、永远想跑路。全游戏喜剧担当——可就是这个怂包，一路活到了罪恶城权力之巅。
vc-ken-rosenberg.en: Vice City's sweatiest lawyer. Panic as a lifestyle, and a catchphrase everyone remembers.

vc-general-cortez.zh: 科尔特斯是流亡美国的古巴老将军，罪恶城上流社会的操盘手。游艇上的每一场宴会都是一次交易——老将军教会了汤米什么叫'体面的犯罪'。
vc-general-cortez.en: The exiled general who plays the city like chess from his yacht. Cigar, medals, and the smile of a man who always knows more.

vc-tommy-vercetti.zh: 汤米为黑手党顶罪入狱十五年，被派到罪恶城做交易却遭埋伏。他从一枚弃子杀回巅峰，最终掌控全城。80 年代粉色霓虹下，暴徒的复仇长成帝国。
vc-tommy-vercetti.en: Tommy did 15 years, got double-crossed in Vice City, and came back to own the whole town. The 1986 neon-noir origin story.

shang-fu-hao.zh: 中国第一位有甲骨文实证的女统帅，王后、将军、大祭司三合一，殷商纪人物志开篇。
shang-fu-hao.en: China's first verifiable female general — queen, commander and high priestess, opening the Yin-Shang Chronicles.

shang-wu-ding.zh: 三年不语、梦得傅说、武丁中兴——商朝最鼎盛的岁月，甲骨时代由此开启。
shang-wu-ding.en: Three silent years, a dream of Fu Shuo, and the golden age of Shang — the era of oracle bones begins.

shang-oracle.zh: 灼裂的龟甲与最早的汉字——'卜'的一声，汉字的故事开始了。
shang-oracle.en: A cracked turtle shell and the earliest Chinese characters — with one 'bu', the story of Hanzi begins.

shang-pan-geng.zh: 盘庚迁殷，让飘摇的王朝在洹水之畔重获根基；“殷商”之名，自此而来。
shang-pan-geng.en: 盘庚迁殷，让飘摇的王朝在洹水之畔重获根基；“殷商”之名，自此而来。

shang-tang.zh: 网开三面的仁德之君，鸣条一战，天命有归。
shang-tang.en: 网开三面的仁德之君，鸣条一战，天命有归。

shang-yi-yin.zh: 治大国若烹小鲜——从灶台到庙堂，一代元圣。
shang-yi-yin.en: 治大国若烹小鲜——从灶台到庙堂，一代元圣。

shang-houmuwu-ding.zh: 中国现存最大青铜鼎，1939 年出土于安阳武官村，国家博物馆镇馆之宝。
shang-houmuwu-ding.en: 中国现存最大青铜鼎，1939 年出土于安阳武官村，国家博物馆镇馆之宝。

shang-fuhao-owl-zun.zh: 1976 年妇好墓出土的猫头鹰形盛酒器，殷商青铜艺术巅峰之作。
shang-fuhao-owl-zun.en: 1976 年妇好墓出土的猫头鹰形盛酒器，殷商青铜艺术巅峰之作。

shang-four-ram-zun.zh: 1938 年出土于湖南宁乡，商代青铜艺术的不朽绝品。
shang-four-ram-zun.en: 1938 年出土于湖南宁乡，商代青铜艺术的不朽绝品。

shang-dark-bird.zh: 《诗经·商颂·玄鸟》：“天命玄鸟，降而生商。”
shang-dark-bird.en: 《诗经·商颂·玄鸟》：“天命玄鸟，降而生商。”

shang-divination.zh: 商王凡事必卜——征战、天象、疾病、生育，皆刻于甲骨。
shang-divination.en: 商王凡事必卜——征战、天象、疾病、生育，皆刻于甲骨。

shang-yin-xu.zh: 安阳殷墟，商朝晚期都城遗址，2006 年列入世界文化遗产。
shang-yin-xu.en: 安阳殷墟，商朝晚期都城遗址，2006 年列入世界文化遗产。

shang-chariot.zh: 商代战车，木质车身青铜饰件，殷墟出土马车遗迹。
shang-chariot.en: 商代战车，木质车身青铜饰件，殷墟出土马车遗迹。

shang-taotie.zh: 饕餮纹（兽面纹），商周青铜器上最常见也最神秘的脸。
shang-taotie.en: 饕餮纹（兽面纹），商周青铜器上最常见也最神秘的脸。

vc-ocean-drive.zh: Ocean Drive is the beating heart of Vice City — a strip of Art Deco hotels, neon signs and palm shadows where every night looks like the cover of a summer album. Convertibles cruise the wet asphalt, radios blast, and the pink dusk never quite ends. In 1986 this was the most famous street in Miami, and in Vice City it was the one you drove to feel alive.
vc-ocean-drive.en: Ocean Drive is the beating heart of Vice City — a strip of Art Deco hotels, neon signs and palm shadows where every night looks like the cover of a summer album. Convertibles cruise the wet asphalt, radios blast, and the pink dusk never quite ends. In 1986 this was the most famous street in Miami, and in Vice City it was the one you drove to feel alive.

vc-starfish-island.zh: Starfish Island is Vice City's most expensive address — a gated strip of waterfront mansions where the drug money of 1986 bought views over the bay. Tommy Vercetti's estate sits here: private pool, private dock, a lawn big enough to park an empire. In the fiction of Vice City, it's the address that proves you made it.
vc-starfish-island.en: Starfish Island is Vice City's most expensive address — a gated strip of waterfront mansions where the drug money of 1986 bought views over the bay. Tommy Vercetti's estate sits here: private pool, private dock, a lawn big enough to park an empire. In the fiction of Vice City, it's the address that proves you made it.

vc-little-havana.zh: Little Havana is where Cuba landed in Miami: strong coffee, dominoes on outdoor tables, cigar smoke, and salsa from every window. It's the turf of the Cuban gang El Sindicato — and in Vice City, the front line of a quiet street war with the Haitians. Brotherhood, rum, and a neighborhood that never forgets home.
vc-little-havana.en: Little Havana is where Cuba landed in Miami: strong coffee, dominoes on outdoor tables, cigar smoke, and salsa from every window. It's the turf of the Cuban gang El Sindicato — and in Vice City, the front line of a quiet street war with the Haitians. Brotherhood, rum, and a neighborhood that never forgets home.

vc-little-haiti.zh: Little Haiti is the shadow-side of Vice City: chain-link gates, painted voodoo shops, and drums that carry through the night. It's the turf of the Haitian gang — and home to Auntie Poulet, whose voodoo deals in favors deeper than money. Between Little Haiti and Little Havana, 1986 Miami fought its quiet war.
vc-little-haiti.en: Little Haiti is the shadow-side of Vice City: chain-link gates, painted voodoo shops, and drums that carry through the night. It's the turf of the Haitian gang — and home to Auntie Poulet, whose voodoo deals in favors deeper than money. Between Little Haiti and Little Havana, 1986 Miami fought its quiet war.

vc-vercetti-estate.zh: Every empire needs a cornerstone. Tommy's was a run-down construction site at the edge of town — bought cheap, rebuilt into a mansion that doubled as his headquarters. The crane above the half-finished walls is the honest symbol of Vice City's dream: concrete, cash, and the nerve to build your own skyline.
vc-vercetti-estate.en: Every empire needs a cornerstone. Tommy's was a run-down construction site at the edge of town — bought cheap, rebuilt into a mansion that doubled as his headquarters. The crane above the half-finished walls is the honest symbol of Vice City's dream: concrete, cash, and the nerve to build your own skyline.

vc-fm-radio.zh: Vice City is nothing without its radio. FM stations pumped new wave, funk, rock and Latin through every open window — the mixtape era's golden hour. A boombox on a hood, a cassette thrown in the air, neon waves leaking from the speakers: this is the sound of 1986, and the city's real soundtrack.
vc-fm-radio.en: Vice City is nothing without its radio. FM stations pumped new wave, funk, rock and Latin through every open window — the mixtape era's golden hour. A boombox on a hood, a cassette thrown in the air, neon waves leaking from the speakers: this is the sound of 1986, and the city's real soundtrack.

vc-dockyard.zh: The docks are Vice City's back door — where the smuggled crates came in and the fast boats went out. At sunset the sky burns orange over the bay while speedboats cut white wakes toward the horizon. On the water, there are no neon signs; just engines, salt, and the fastest road out of town.
vc-dockyard.en: The docks are Vice City's back door — where the smuggled crates came in and the fast boats went out. At sunset the sky burns orange over the bay while speedboats cut white wakes toward the horizon. On the water, there are no neon signs; just engines, salt, and the fastest road out of town.

vc-neon-1986.zh: 1986 was the year of excess: muscle cars, padded shoulders, wristwatches that told two time zones, and a skyline bought on credit. Vice City is that era distilled — cocaine economics, real-estate fever, and neon in three colors. Big cars, big hair, big dreams: the decade that burned brightest.
vc-neon-1986.en: 1986 was the year of excess: muscle cars, padded shoulders, wristwatches that told two time zones, and a skyline bought on credit. Vice City is that era distilled — cocaine economics, real-estate fever, and neon in three colors. Big cars, big hair, big dreams: the decade that burned brightest.
